task_definition.instruction_en: In a fixed robotic workspace, generate a rigid, physically consistent embodied robotic arm. The arm maintains high stability with no deformation and enters the frame to Ensure the smooth dark gray computer mouse is placed on the right of the rubikscube cube shape.
task_definition.instruction_zh: 在固定的机器人工作空间中，生成刚性的、物理一致的具体机器人手臂。手臂保持高稳定性，不变形，进入框架，确保光滑的深灰色电脑鼠标放置在魔方立方体形状的右侧。
